svg.title: SaaS Sales Pod Architecture
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-saas-sales-pod-architecture; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: SaaS Sales Pod Architecture; subtitle: Numbers-first pod built around the account executive; caption: The AE carries a quota near 5x OTE, fed by SDR dialing, a CRO champion, a procurement gate held on price, and CRM renewal automation.; assumptions note: Quota multiples reported range from 5x (SaasRise) to 5.6-6.1x (QuotaPath), with a Bridge median of 4.6x; 48% of reps hit quota.; note: Attributed to Sell Better, Caliber, SaasRise, GrowthSpree and HubSpot Data Analytics by MergeYourData.; center: role: Mid-Market Account Executive; headcount: 1 AE per 2 SDRs, never above 2.5 to 1; focus: Quota at 5x OTE; a $200K median OTE rep brings in about $1M; spokes: role: SDR; type: Outbound dialing; kpi: 40 calls per hour; 200 calls per week for at least 2 meetings; role: CRO Champion; type: Internal sponsor; kpi: Rates the business case very believable in the room; role: Procurement; type: Buyer gate; kpi: Price kept as the final issue; terms only after cash is the last objection; role: CRM Automation; type: Renewal engine; kpi: Workflow fires when renewal date is under 30 days out
